limits: The original fully activated calibration coordinates, material parameters and embedded sheet reference areas/rest lengths are frozen. No optimizer, force fitting, contact or time advancement is invoked.

The full nodal free set excludes the explicit source distal/proximal P2 cap node sets. Original free-mode leakage and frozen cap displacement are checked at binary64 roundoff scale; no physical cap is released by a tiny interpolation coefficient.

Independent nodal sheet forces project to the original 63-coordinate assembly. Complete dense nodal forces project to the prior frozen 256-point reduced residual. Two perturbation sizes independently crosscheck the largest free component.
Nodal cap reactions and reduced boundary-coordinate reactions at a nonstationary pose are distinct diagnostics; neither is an equilibrated full nodal force match.
Failing full nodal stationarity and severe local compression block physical calibration. These frozen states are not accepted full nodal equilibria.
